name: Margie's Bar & Grill
tagline: Opersteny Burgers off the original grill since 1924, on North Main in Historic Downtown Bryan.
about_title: Burgers on the same grill since 1924
about: Margie's opened in 1924 as the Opersteny Saloon, on the north end of Main Street in Historic Downtown Bryan. The Opersteny family's burgers were so good that people licked the juice off the paper wrappers.
More than 100 years later, the Opersteny Burger is still made the old-fashioned way on the original grill. Texas Time Travel featured Margie's in its "10 Burger Joints with a Story."

reviews.name: Brandon
reviews.text: Margie's has the best burger in town and the onion rings are wonderful. I always have to get the Opersteny Burger!

reviews.name: David
reviews.text: I'm not a local but I've been to Margie's multiple times and they have the best burger I've ever had in my 54 years.

reviews.name: A Foursquare reviewer
reviews.text: Burgers are amazingly delicious. Service is excellent. Hats off to the cook thank you for lunch today.
